subject: Request to reopen expired trial credits — grace period appeal
messages:
From: Jordan Meyers <jordan@nebulahealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Trial credits expired — request to reopen / short grace period

Hi Ben,

Quick note — our evaluation of Redwood got paused last week when we had to put hiring and external spend on hold. We were in the middle of running an inference quality sweep when the sandbox credits expired (noticed on Nov 18).

We still have the tests and prompts ready; we need another short window (2–4 weeks) to finish the comparison and validate with our privacy/security team before we can move to procurement. Is there any way you can reopen or extend the trial credits (or grant a short grace) so the engineering team can finish the POC? We tried to salvage a few runs but we’re blocked.

Attached is a small CSV that shows their usage and the checkpoints we planned (trial-summary.csv). We’re trying to be efficient — estimate another ~40k tokens/day for two weeks.

Appreciate any help — happy to share our timeline and calendar for a quick sync.

Thanks,
Jordan Meyers
Head of ML, Nebula Health
---
Nebula Health | jordan@nebulahealth.com

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Meyers <jordan@nebulahealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Trial credits expired — request to reopen / short grace period

Hi Jordan — thanks for the note and the CSV. Sorry to hear the hiring freeze threw a wrench in the timeline.

Short answer: yes, we can often grant a short grace/reactivation for customers in evaluation while they finish a POC. I’ll need to route this through Sales Ops and Finance (cc’ing Laura & Monica) but can provision a limited reactivation quickly if approved.

Before I ask for approvals, two quick clarifying Qs that will help the Ops review:
- Confirm expected duration: you mentioned 2–4 weeks; is 30 days OK?
- Approximate tokens/credits needed: you estimated ~40k tokens/day for two weeks — would you like us to provision 500 credits (good for ~30 days) or a higher amount?

If 30 days + 500 credits covers it, I’ll push for a fast approval and confirm terms. If you need more, please let me know the business justification (evaluation to procurement timeline, expected monthly spend after POC).

I’ll follow up once Laura/Rishi chime in.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com | (415) 555-0126

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 10:17:00 -0800
Subject: FW: Nebula Health — credit reactivation request

Laura / Rishi / Monica — forwarding a request from Nebula Health (Jordan Meyers). Trial expired Nov 18; they paused evaluation due to a temporary hiring/budget hold and need a short window to finish a POC.

Summary:
- Request: 30-day reactivation / grace window to run remaining tests.
- Suggested provisional grant: 500 free credits (estimated ~40k tokens/day for ~2 weeks)
- Business case: Strong fit for Redwood in healthcare inference workflows; technical team already ran initial runs and we’re mid-eval (high chance to convert once security signoff cleared).
- Risk: Low (sandbox usage, no production data).

Attachments: trial-usage-report.pdf (historical trial runs).

Could you approve 500 credits for 30 days? If you prefer, we could do 500 now and escalate +500 later pending a brief internal review.

Thanks — Ben

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 14:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: FW: Nebula Health — credit reactivation request

Ben — thanks for the context and the usage report. Approve an initial 500-credit reactivation for 30 days under standard trial-extension terms.

Rishi — FYI / please sign off on the accounting side. If finance is comfortable, we can provision the first 500 immediately. For any additional credits beyond 500, Sales should provide a short conversion plan that demonstrates procurement timing (e.g., expected PO within 60 days).

I’ll drop the terms into Drive and send Ben a stub email to send to the customer.

Laura Bennett
Senior Sales Ops Manager

Subject: Re: Trial credits expired — request to reopen / short grace period

Jordan — good news: we can offer a 30-day grace extension and have reactivated 500 free credits on your sandbox account to let your engineering team finish the POC.

Summary of terms (attached): trial-extension-terms.pdf
- Reactivated: 500 credits, valid for 30 days from today (Nov 22, 2026).
- Intended use: evaluation/sandbox only; not for production workloads.
- Conversion guidance: if Nebula expects to progress to procurement within 60 days, reply with an estimated PO date and we can discuss an additional 500-credit uplift.

Next steps:
1) Use the sandbox credentials as before — I’ve confirmed the account mapping and the credits are live.
2) If you’d like, schedule a 30–45 minute technical deep-dive next week — I can bring Monica (solutions engineer) to help with the remaining tests.
3) If procurement wants formal terms, send a contact at procurement@nebulahealth.com and we’ll fast-track the PO checklist.
